sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was reduced across all key metrics: full-year revenue guidance lowered to flat to down 1%, operating margin guided down 380 basis points, and EPS guidance cut to $10.95-$11.15 from $13.26. Management explicitly cited negative brand commentary, underperforming product launches, and tariff headwinds as ongoing risks. The guidance reduction is material and organic, not attributed to one-time items.

summary.revenue: Net revenue $2.5 billion, up 4% (2% constant currency). North America revenue decreased 3%, China Mainland increased 30% (23% constant currency), Rest of World increased 13% (9% constant currency).
summary.eps: Diluted EPS $1.69 compared to $2.60 prior year.
summary.guidance: Q2 revenue $2.45B-$2.475B (decline 2%-3%), EPS $1.76-$1.81. Full-year revenue $11B-$11.15B (flat to down 1%), EPS $10.95-$11.15 vs $13.26 prior year. Operating margin ~11.6% for Q2 and full year.
summary.margin: Q1 gross margin 54.2% (down 410 bps), operating margin 11.2% (down from 18.5%). Full-year gross margin guided down 90 bps, operating margin down 380 bps.
key_risks: Negative brand commentary in media and social channels impacting traffic and top line
Underperformance of certain product launches (e.g., Look of Yoga campaign)
Tariff headwinds: 280 bps negative impact in Q1, 150 bps expected in Q2, 30 bps for full year
Fixed cost deleverage from store investments and distribution network
Higher markdowns in Q2 (up 50 bps) due to slower top-line trends
Proxy contest costs and layering back of expenses (store labor, incentive comp)
Disruption in Middle East franchise business due to conflict in Iran
Softer tourism in Europe and Japan
key_opportunities: China Mainland growth: Q1 revenue up 30%, full-year expected ~20% growth
Rest of World growth: Q1 up 13%, full-year mid-teens growth expected
Product innovation: newness penetration targeted to rise to 35% of assortment from 23%
Chase program: 20% more volume chased to improve inventory flexibility
Reduced product lead time from 18-24 months to 15-16 months, targeting 12-14 months
Enterprise efficiency initiatives: supply chain optimization, procurement, AI-powered systems
Brand activations: SeaWheeze, Great Wall of China yoga, summer sweat games
Store experience enhancements: 15% fewer SKUs, improved merchandising, reduced markdowns

management_tone.label: cautious
management_tone.justification: Management acknowledged 'a few headwinds and a moderating sales trend' and reduced guidance across all metrics, while emphasizing they are 'moving with urgency' but not expressing confidence in near-term recovery.
